# East of England Summit 2027 (EoES 2027)

> A community-led Microsoft conference in Norwich, run by volunteers. It covers the whole Microsoft stack plus AI: AI and Copilot, Fabric, Azure, Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365 and Power Platform. Formerly the East of England Power Platform Summit (EoEPPS).

- When: Friday 30 April 2027, paid hands-on workshops (09:00 to 16:30, lunch included). Saturday 1 May 2027, free conference day (08:00 to 17:30).
- Where: The Space, Roundtree Way, Norwich NR7 8SQ. Free parking on site.
- Cost: the Saturday conference is free. The Friday workshops are a paid ticket with limited places.
- Register for a free ticket: https://app.eoes.co.uk/e/eoes-2027/register
- Speak: the call for speakers is on Sessionize and is open until Thursday 14 January 2027: https://sessionize.com/east-of-england-summit-2027
- Sponsor: https://www.eoes.co.uk/sponsorship/ or email info@eoes.co.uk
- Organiser: East of England Tech Community Ltd (company no. 16951004).
- Contact: info@eoes.co.uk
